title: MonaCode G6-R Task State Machine Schema
description: Closed contract for the G6-R fail-closed task-state machine and its lifecycle interfaces. Evidence states are exactly absent/running/failed/passed. The machine exposes nextTask (lexicographic topological selection), beginTaskEvidence (beginning-journal recovery protocol), resumeTaskEvidence (crash-residue recovery predicate), auditTaskEvidence (dependency + provenance audit), finalizeTaskEvidence (passed-byte construction + product commit proof), and selectEvidenceCommit (first-parent evidence selector). Every transition is fail-closed: an invariant failure moves the task to `failed` with exactly one stable finding ID. additionalProperties: false at every layer.

evidenceStates.description: The closed evidence state set. `absent` is the implicit pre-begin state (no running file); the other three are record states.

transitions.description: beginTaskEvidence: absent -> running. resumeTaskEvidence: failed|running -> running (or failed on predicate violation). finalizeTaskEvidence: running -> passed (or failed on product-commit proof violation). An unexpected Red/Green attempt stays running; a toolchain/authority/workspace-token/mutation-policy/evidence-integrity finding moves to failed.

prefixStates.description: A retry accepts only the five non-empty prefix states of the five ordered operations and produces identical running bytes.

firstParentAncestry.description: The product commit must be on repoHead's first-parent ancestry.

immediateSuccessor.description: Selects the first commit of productCommit..repoHead in first-parent chronological order; that commit must have the product commit as its sole parent, match the evidence identity/subject contract, and change exactly the declared evidence path to the bytes under validation.

rejectsLaterTouches.description: git rev-list --first-parent EVIDENCE_COMMIT..repoHead -- EVIDENCE_PATH must return no commit (rejects modification, deletion, and modify-then-restore).

productCommit.description: The passed JSON contains the product commit.

prohibitsSelfEmbedding.description: The passed JSON contains neither its own blob hash (passedSha256) nor its evidence commit ID.

findingIDs.description: The stable evidence-truth finding IDs. Each mutation class yields its stable ID so evidence validation is deterministic across runs.
